notes.title: Yukiiro Sign - The Store Page is now Open!!
notes.content:
Yukiiro Sign is coming this Spring. Don't forget to add it to your wishlist!

[list]
[*] 20+ hours of story ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Three branching heroine routes ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Full Japanese voice acting by seasoned professionals ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Japanese countryside（Tohoku region）ːsteamthumbsupː
[/list]
Yukiiro Sign  has received several awards in Japan, which includes the User Favorite Award.
To know more about the game, tap the "READ MORE" in our store page!
